steps: Replay via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: math.transforms, typed inputs from the reference case} (or solve.direct once SC-00 lands): {F: "1/(s+1)", t: [0.5, 1, 2]} target inverse-laplace → PASS with e^{−t} at each t within 1e-6 (the build measures ~1e-12; 1/s → 1 and 1/(s²+1) → sin t are pinned beside it) — the DLMF transform pairs, never the solver's own output.

Envelope leg: {f: "1", s: [0]} target laplace → NOT_COMPUTED outside_envelope — s ≤ 0 is outside the certified envelope and refused by name; the forward transform integrates by three-level tanh–sinh quadrature on a window whose tail bound is computed from a sampled bound on |f| and reported in the result, and the three levels must settle or the call refuses.

Check the envelope: status, outputs within the declared tolerance, inputs echo (inputs used == inputs submitted); every FFT result carries two certificates computed on the call itself — the round-trip error and the Parseval relative error (CI pins both < 1e-11) — and the Haar DWT carries an exact reconstruction certificate (< 1e-12); non-power-of-two lengths beyond 512 name the FFTW tier and deeper wavelet families name the PyWavelets tier, rather than being approximated.

Adversarial: NaN / 1e300 input → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; missing F, f, t, or s → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field; a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted; a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
